items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: This was later. He didn't come in till the 40's. Milt was with MCA, then later he went with William Morris. He became the big man.

ctx.x: Of course. I was sitting there, I didn't know about this guy. So John came in and I looked at him and said, "John, you don't impress me." And we went through a personal thing. I said, "You don't want to see me; you want to see Basie." But he didn't know where Basie was. I did, so I got Basie for him. Then John left and then when he came back with Willard Alexander, because Willard was building the Benny Goodman band with Gene Krupa and Lionel Hampton.
What about this other manager that you mentioned, Milt Evans or somebody?

This was later. He didn't come in till the 40's. Milt was with MCA, then later he went with William Morris. He became the big man. Mr. Willard Alexander was the biggest man in the promotional business, GAC or what have you. He was the only one that knew because -
